subject.title: feat(ios): Siri App Intent integration — native "Hey Siri, ask OpenClaw..." support

question: Should first-party iOS Siri/AppIntent execution be added, and if so should it route through paired operator chat.send, node.event agent.request, or a hardened hooks boundary with explicit confirmation and spoken-reply policy?
rationale: The codebase has adjacent chat, Talk, share, and hook primitives, but choosing which may execute agent work from Siri affects auth, session state, confirmation, and user-visible security posture.

options.title: Approve Design-Gated Native Intent
options.body: Implement Siri/AppIntent support after maintainers choose the auth boundary, session semantics, confirmation policy, and spoken-reply behavior, then require real iOS device proof.

options.title: Limit To Talk Mode Launch
options.body: Support Shortcuts or Action Button only as an app/Talk Mode launcher and keep parameterized Siri questions out of scope for now.

options.title: Keep Webhook Workaround External
options.body: Decline first-party Siri agent execution until demand or a safer extension/API story is stronger, leaving Shortcuts plus webhook as the workaround.

recommendation.title: Approve Design-Gated Native Intent
recommendation.body: Implement Siri/AppIntent support after maintainers choose the auth boundary, session semantics, confirmation policy, and spoken-reply behavior, then require real iOS device proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest evidence-backed owner signal is recent first-party iOS product direction work on the affected app surfaces.
